subject: Request to move Oct 31 demo — team at conference next week
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@fintechlabs.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Cc: Sana Patel <sana@fintechlabs.com>
Date: 2026-10-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Demo for Fintech Labs — Oct 31 at 11am PT

Hi Rishi,

Thanks for scheduling the walkthrough. We confirmed Oct 31 at 11am PT internally and sent calendar invites, but a couple of our product folks just flagged that the team has a critical presence at the Payments Summit in NYC that week and a few key reviewers will be traveling.

Would you have any flexibility to move the demo to the following week? We really want the full payments team in attendance to sign off on integration questions.

Suggested slots: Nov 3 (Wed) 10:00–11:00 PT or Nov 4 (Thu) 1:00–2:00 PT. If neither works we can propose more.

Apologies for the late heads-up — travel plans shifted last minute.

Best,
Liam
Principal Product Manager
Fintech Labs

Attachment: travel-itinerary.pdf (stub)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@fintechlabs.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, Sana Patel <sana@fintechlabs.com>
Date: 2026-10-30T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Demo for Fintech Labs — Oct 31 at 11am PT

Hi Liam — thanks for the heads-up.

Completely understand — conference attendance is one of those things that sneaks up on everyone. Monica (CS lead) and I can shift — we have a company-wide blackout for re:Invent prep the week of Nov 15, so moving into early November is ideal.

I listed the two slots you suggested and added a couple more options to increase chances of a match: Nov 3 10–11am PT, Nov 3 2–3pm PT, Nov 4 1–2pm PT, Nov 5 9–10am PT. Monica, can you confirm which of these we can staff? Lauren, flagging because there are a couple of follow-on stakeholders who may need to join the session (technical architecture & procurement).

If it helps, I'm attaching an updated agenda and an availability ICS that your team can drop into their calendars. We'll hold the original invite tentative until we lock a new time.

Thanks — I'll update the HubSpot deal when the slot is confirmed.

Best regards,
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

Attachments: proposed-agenda.pdf, new-times-availability.ics

> I listed the two slots you suggested and added a couple more options to increase chances of a match: Nov 3 10–11am PT, Nov 3 2–3pm PT, Nov 4 1–2pm PT, Nov 5 9–10am PT.

All of those look doable from CS. I'll take Nov 3 10–11am PT as our preferred slot — it gives us time to prep and get responses from the payments folks returning from travel that morning.

Lauren — could you join for the procurement questions at the end? We typically leave 10–15 minutes for SOW/billing/terms in demos where procurement may be present.

Rishi — once Liam confirms I'll send updated calendar invites and include the short decision checklist (who needs approvals, expected SOW timeline).

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Rishi / Monica — Nov 3 10–11am PT works for us. I've updated invites and added our Head of Payments (Sana) and a couple of engineers who'll be on-site that morning.

A couple quick asks before the session:
- Can you add a short slide on privacy/data flow (we'll need that for our security review)?
- Please include brief notes on latency expectations at 2k TPS — our SREs will ask.

Otherwise we'll be ready. Looking forward to seeing Redwood's runtime in action.

Thanks,
Liam
